# Veda Sera

> Veda Sera makes handwoven cotton yoga mats (100% cotton, 61 × 188 cm × 8 mm), sold in Korea via Naver Smart Store. Two colourways: Forest Green and Midnight Blue, ₩198,000 each.

## Verified product record (Setu product hub)

- [Verified catalog page](https://vedasera.com/catalog.html): every product claim with its source and verification status
- [Machine-readable catalog feed (JSON, schema.org)](https://vedasera.com/catalog.json): the same record for agents to pull directly — price, stock, weight, category, ratings, per-claim verification
